name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r2-ctlr2-COMMIT
purpose: Native-audit successor of the closed ctl (capture 304.0 ps on 33 pins: cmd_src/cmd_dst/cmd_op/cmd_block feed the constant-port pack and range-check adders before the first flop). r2 registers every cmd_* bit at its pin (one capture flop, the only load of the pin; keep_pin_regs anchors it at the W face) and runs the unchanged controller from the registers: +1 edge on the whole controller, measured in the exact QUANT bench (TSPLIT=2 LG=2).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r2 #(.RL(9), .DL(25), .WC(5), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/static/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_split.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/qw/static/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_r2.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: QDQ_TSPLIT_exact
bench.cmd: IO_REGS=1 LG=2 TSPLIT=2 bash tools/hgi_unit_tput/run_qdq_static.sh {RUN}/bench_tsplit && cat {RUN}/bench_tsplit/m0.log

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r2/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r2/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r2 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r2  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run
